items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: And then Ori comes up to join Joe Oliver and he had Bob Schaffner and Tick Gray on trumpets. And he had the same Charlie Jackson on bass, bass horn, and he had Albert Nichols and Bonnie Bigard on the- and Darnell Howard.

ctx.x: Yeah, Kelly Stables. And Joe Oliver, he went in with Dave Payton at the plantation. So I visited first one place or another, and Louis Armstrong, by that time Louis left the band and went to New York to join Fletcher Henderson I think. And then Louis goes and joins Fletcher Henderson. And then Ori comes up to join Joe Oliver and he had Bob Schaffner and Tick Gray on trumpets. And he had the same Charlie Jackson on bass, bass horn, and he had Albert Nichols and Bonnie Bigard on the- and Darnell Howard. Well…

items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: We had Darnell Howard, and somebody else.

ctx.x: The horn might be on another train.

See they rediscovered him from New Ile Berry. He was in New Ile Berry, they were working. And so Bunk played that night, and George Brunus was there, and Paul Morales, and we had Brother McGrummers on the piano, and Lee Collins, he used Lee Collins on. We had Darnell Howard, and somebody else.
What did you think about Bunk playing then?
